Is Wood-Look Flooring the Same as Hardwood? What New Jersey Homeowners Should Know Before Choosing One of the most common questions during flooring consultations in East Brunswick is whether wood-look plank and hardwood are the same thing. They are not, and the difference matters depending on where the floor is going. Hardwood is solid milled wood. It works well in bedrooms and living rooms but cannot handle moisture consistently. Kitchens, bathrooms, and New Jersey basements are risky placements because humidity causes solid wood to expand and contract over time. Luxury vinyl plank is what shows up in most finished renovation photos today. It is waterproof, installs over most existing subfloors including concrete, and comes in realistic wood tones that are difficult to distinguish from the real thing. For rooms that see moisture or heavy foot traffic in Woodbridge, Edison, and Piscataway, LVP is the more practical choice. Pro Tip: If the subfloor has minor imperfections, LVP is more forgiving than hardwood and requires less prep work before installation.

From the owner
Choosing the Right Siding: Where Design Meets Durability One of the biggest decisions in any exterior remodeling project is choosing the right siding. And while color is usually where homeowners start, there’s a lot more worth considering before making that investment. Different siding materials offer different advantages when it comes to maintenance, durability, appearance and cost. Some provide a more traditional look, while others allow for cleaner lines, different textures and more contemporary architectural details. The right choice depends on the home itself, how much maintenance you’re comfortable with, and the overall look you’re trying to achieve. It’s also important to think beyond the siding alone. The roof, windows, trim and even the proportions of the home all influence how a particular material or color will look once it’s installed. Something that looks great in a sample or on another house may not be the best choice for yours. At Remodel Design by Bongiovanni, we’ve spent more than 40 years helping homeowners navigate these decisions. We believe the best exterior projects start with understanding the home, discussing the options and choosing materials that make sense for both the design and the years ahead. The contractor who thinks like a designer. Serving homeowners throughout Bergen County, including Oradell, River Edge, Paramus, Ridgewood, Westwood and surrounding New Jersey communities.

Whether you are updating a coastal cottage or modernizing a multi-story beachside residence, we handle every single step of your renovation under one roof. No juggling separate contractors, no design miscommunication—just seamless project delivery tailored to breezy, modern coastal living. Our Complete A-to-Z Scope: Custom Coastal Kitchens: Minimalist flat-panel or shaker cabinetry, durable quartz and porcelain waterfall slabs, expansive entertaining islands, and layered architectural task lighting. Spa-Grade Primary Baths: Curb-less frameless walk-in showers, sculptural deep-soaking bathtubs, floating double vanities, and precision artisan tile and stone work. Structural Layout Reconfigurations: Removing cramped dividing walls to maximize natural light and improve sightlines throughout your most-used spaces. Turnkey Project Management: Transparent upfront estimates, city permit handling, disciplined milestone scheduling, and clean, dust-sealed worksites every day. We handle the entire journey from A to Z so you can simply enjoy the finished result.
